an3.127:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an3.127:1.2: atha kho hatthako devaputto abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā
an3.127:1.3: bhagavato purato ṭhassāmīti osīdati ceva saṃsīdati ca, na sakkoti saṇṭhātuṃ.
an3.127:1.4: seyyathāpi nāma sappiṃ vā telaṃ vā vālikāya āsittaṃ osīdati saṃsīdati na saṇṭhāti.
an3.127:1.6: bhagavato purato ṭhassāmīti osīdati ceva saṃsīdati ca, na sakkoti saṇṭhātuṃ.
an3.127:2.1: atha kho bhagavā hatthakaṃ devaputtaṃ etadavoca :
an3.127:2.3: evaṃ bhanteti kho hatthako devaputto bhagavato paṭissutvā oḷārikaṃ attabhāvaṃ abhinimminitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
an3.127:2.4: ekamantaṃ ṭhitaṃ kho hatthakaṃ devaputtaṃ bhagavā etadavoca :
an3.127:3.1: ye te hatthaka, dhammā pubbe manussabhūtassa pavattino ahesuṃ, api nu te te dhammā etarahi pavattinoti?
an3.127:3.2: ye ca me bhante, dhammā pubbe manussabhūtassa pavattino ahesuṃ, te ca me dhammā etarahi pavattino.
an3.127:3.3: ye ca me bhante, dhammā pubbe manussabhūtassa nappavattino ahesuṃ, te ca me dhammā etarahi pavattino.
an3.127:3.4: seyyathāpi bhante, bhagavā etarahi ākiṇṇo viharati bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīhi upāsakehi upāsikāhi rājūhi rājamahāmattehi titthiyehi titthiyasāvakehi,
an3.127:3.5: evameva kho ahaṃ bhante, ākiṇṇo viharāmi devaputtehi.
an3.127:3.6: dūratopi bhante, devaputtā āgacchanti hatthakassa devaputtassa santike dhammaṃ sossāmāti.
an3.127:3.7: tiṇṇāhaṃ bhante, dhammānaṃ atitto appaṭivāno kālakato.
an3.127:3.9: bhagavato ahaṃ bhante, dassanassa atitto appaṭivāno kālakato.
an3.127:3.11: saṅghassāhaṃ bhante, upaṭṭhānassa atitto appaṭivāno kālakato.
an3.127:3.12: imesaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante, tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ atitto appaṭivāno kālakatoti.
